claim: GOTTR arms the TREFF warp-in for thirty frames: LDA #30 / STA PFRAME,U (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5726-5727). This is the same 30 STAND_FRAMES transcribes; WARPIN_FRAME_COUNT re-derives from it.

TREFF constant-fills the transporter in the owner's colour while active: LDB DCONST,Y "COLORED TRANSPORTER WHEN ACTIVE" (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5739). DCONST is a per-process colour nibble seeded from each decision block's FCB: P1 yellow (PL1=$5, :52), P2 green (PL2=$7, :54), enemies white (FCB WHI*$11, :5561/:5565; WHI=$1, :57) — paintWarpIn's owner colour.

source.verbatim: LDB	DCONST,Y	COLORED TRANSPORTER WHEN ACTIVE

claim: The bird silhouette is drawn only for PFRAME <= 20: LDA PFRAME,U / CMPA #20 / BGT TREFF2 (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5741-5743). WARPIN_BIRD_VISIBLE_PFRAME re-derives from the #20; the first ten frames show only the lit pad.

The standing silhouette's vertical DMA size WCLENY is derived from PFRAME: COMA "VERT SIZE" / ASRA / ANDA #$0F / EORA #$04 / STA WCLENY,X (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5753-5757). It grows as PFRAME falls; paintWarpIn grows the bar the same way.
TREFF2 holds one nap per frame: PCNAP 1 "EFFECTS TIME" (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5792). WARPIN_FRAME_NAPS re-derives from it — one nap per DEC PFRAME iteration.
The window loops thirty times, PFRAME 30->0: DEC PFRAME,U / LBNE TREFF (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5802-5803).

The full transporter materialisation sequence (the 30-frame TREFF grow-in THEN the unmodeled wait-for-first-move phase :5805-5890) ends by enabling the arrival's collisions at PLYINT: LDA #$80 "ENABLE THIS PLAYERS COLISIONS" / ORA PID,U / STA PID,U (JOUSTRV4.SRC:5923-5925). The clone's WarpInState.done marks only the grow-in end, not this.
